title: Useful Dimensions
description: Adds new resource-based dimensions to the game, pairing a specific material with a specific biome
body:
Adds new dimensions that a combination of a specific material and a specific biome

![coal dimension](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b84b5ac7eb4f6a0d18f3b44c3e9e21f78e840c6a.png)
a mix between coal ore and the jungle biome

![iron dimension](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5902b27d47dd4dd4c8efda834fc8de40ceef6f64.png)
a mix between iron ore and the cherry blossom biome

![gold dimension](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d451b72f88650be9f5cec206d13354ee6aaf85d5.png)
a mix between gold ore and the badlands
